authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant structural artifacts typical of AI generation. The most severe defect is the fusion of the vertical trumpet with the central candle holder; the brass tubing appears to melt into the candle and holder, violating physical solidity. The foreground horizontal trumpet has nonsensical geometry where pipes connect impossibly and valve sections lack definition. Candle wax textures appear slightly plastic-like rather than translucent. These structural collapses and missing functional parts (mouthpieces, finger hooks) reduce authenticity. However, the lighting and overall composition are coherent, preventing a total collapse of the score.
